abstract: BACKGROUND: Choriocarcinoma of the fallopian tube is extremely rare as is choriocarcinoma with a viable pregnancy. We present an unusual case of prima gravida at 33 weeks gestation that was diagnosed as having tubal choriocarcinoma which was successfully treated by chemotherapy. CASE: A 31-year-old prima gravida at 32(+3) weeks gestation was admitted complaining of dyspnea and blood tinged sputum. Suspecting a left adnexal malignant tumor with pulmonary metastasis, delivery of the baby for optimal treatment of the mother's tumor was planned. Cesarean delivery was performed because of induction failure. Tumorectomy with left salpingectomy and infracolic omentectomy was performed for a left tubal tumor. Microscopic findings revealed choriocarcinoma with extensive hemorrhage. Its FIGO stage was III and its WHO prognostic score 12, representing high risk. After 4 cycles of chemotherapy, serum beta-hCG level fell to the normal range. The patient and her baby remain disease-free 16 months after disease diagnosis. CONCLUSION: This is the first reported case of tubal choriocarcinoma coexistent with a viable pregnancy, in which the baby survived and the mother was successfully treated by chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵管絨毛癌は極めて稀であり、生存中の妊娠を伴う絨毛癌はさらに稀である。妊娠33週の初産婦が卵管絨毛癌と診断され、化学療法で治療に成功した、通常ではない症例を報告する。症例：31歳の初産婦が妊娠32週(+3日)で、呼吸困難と血性喀痰を訴えて入院した。左付属器の悪性腫瘍と肺転移を疑い、母体の腫瘍の最適な治療のため分娩が計画された。誘発分娩が奏効しなかったため帝王切開術が施行された。左卵管腫瘍に対して腫瘍摘出術、左卵管摘出術、結腸下大網切除術を行った。顕微鏡的所見では、著明な出血を伴う絨毛癌であった。FIGO病期分類はIII期、WHO予後スコアは12点で、高リスクであった。化学療法4コース後、血清β-hCG値は正常範囲に低下した。患者と児は、疾患診断から16か月後も再発なく経過している。結論：これは、生存中の妊娠に併存した卵管絨毛癌の初めての報告であり、児は生存し、母体は化学療法により治療に成功した。
